instruction.text: Choose which stylistic device is represented.

atoms.a: Powerful presidents preach promises of peace.
The vote was a slow, lonely hope that glowed through the smoke.
The protest ended with the crack of tear gas canisters and the thud of running boots.
The policy includes subsidies, reforms, incentives, and initiatives — all stitched together in the name of progress.
Governing a divided nation is like steering a ship through fog — you must trust the compass more than the crew’s quarrels.
We will rise in hope. We will stand in truth. We will march for justice.

And still,
the city sleeps beneath its own
electric hum.
The report cited corruption, inefficiency, voter apathy, and misinformation as key threats to democracy.
She came to heal, not to harm; to build, not to break.
I urge you to go vote, vote, vote.
Like Pandora’s box, the new bill unleashed more problems than it solved.

hint.text: Pandora's box is a Greek myth about the first woman, Pandora, who, although forbidden, opened a sealed box given to her by Zeus, releasing all the evils into the world.
hint.label: hint

atoms.b: The speech was so long it could have lasted ((++a_century a_minute ten_minutes)).
“((++Brilliant Sad Horrific)) leadership,” he muttered, as the government’s plan fell apart on day one.

hint.text: The utterance needs to mean the opposite of what is said. A failing government plan is a negative incident.
hint.label: hint

atoms.b: The minister of ((++peace economic_affairs transport)) was arrested after starting a fight outside parliament.
The rebel toasted to freedom, ((++not_knowing wondering_if being_aware)) his comrade had betrayed the cause.
In the same alley, the homeless man slept beside a ((++luxury small broken)) car.
Can a nation truly heal while its people stay broken((++? . !))
After the scandal became public, the senator called it “a ((++slight huge grand)) misstep”.
I used to be a banker, but I lost ((++interest inspiration motivation)).

hint.text: Interest in banking is the fee paid by a borrower for using borrowed money, and it is the reward a bank pays a saver for depositing funds.
hint.label: hint

atoms.b: The alarm clock ((++screamed rang buzzed)) at me to get out of bed before sunrise.
She watched the ((++dove duck parrot)) take flight, knowing that peace had finally returned to the valley.
The ((++suits business_people student)) walked into the meeting room looking serious and prepared.
